name: How does exterior window trim impact my home's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: How does exterior window trim impact my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly installed exterior window trim contributes to your home's energy efficiency by helping to seal gaps around window frames. When trim is correctly fitted and sealed, it acts as a barrier, preventing air leaks that can lead to heat loss in winter and heat gain in summer. This reduces the workload on your HVAC system and can result in lower energy bills. Conversely, damaged or poorly installed trim can create pathways for air infiltration, compromising your home's thermal performance. Regular inspection of your trim can help maintain this efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly installed exterior window trim improves energy efficiency by sealing gaps around windows, preventing air leaks, and reducing HVAC strain. Damaged trim can lead to air infiltration.
